title: Tax returns say a federal audit was done; the federal clearinghouse does not have it

beats.text: A nonprofit’s tax return asks: was a federal single audit required? And was it done?

visual.label: Form 990 · Part XII, lines 3a and 3b
visual.sub: Was a single audit required? Was it done?

beats.text: 77 returns, from 34 City-funded organizations, answer yes.
The federal clearinghouse, where such audits are filed, holds none for those years.

visual.label: Federal Audit Clearinghouse
visual.sub: no audit of them for those years

beats.text: This is a lead, not a finding.

visual.line: This is a lead, not a finding: a pattern in public records. This film says what the records show, what they do not show, and what would settle it.

beats.text: The City paid 21 of those organizations 239 million dollars in the years concerned.

visual.label: paid by the City to 21 of them in the years concerned

beats.text: In 74 of the 77, the return also says the audit was done.

visual.sub: the return also says the audit was done

beats.text: Nine of the 21 have no audit on file for any year since 2016.

visual.sub: no audit on file for any year since 2016

beats.text: Providence Foundation of San Francisco: four returns in a row say required, and done.

visual.kicker: Providence Foundation of San Francisco · returns
visual.text: December 2021 to December 2024: a single audit was required and was done

beats.text: No audit of it since 2016. The City paid it 30.2 million dollars.

visual.label: paid by the City in those years

beats.text: Hyde Street, Mission Hiring Hall, Rafiki Coalition: the same, year after year.

visual.label: No audit on file in any year since 2016
rows: Cultura Y Arte Nativa De Las Americas
Rafiki Coalition For Health And Wellness

beats.text: Instituto Familiar De La Raza filed audits for 2018, 2019 and 2020. Then they stop.

visual.label: Instituto Familiar De La Raza Inc
visual.sub: audits on file for 2018, 2019, 2020, then none

beats.text: Its next four returns each say an audit was required, and done.

a: last audit on file, year to June 2020

beats.text: In those years, the City paid it 49.2 million dollars.

visual.label: paid by the City in those 4 years

beats.text: Three returns go further. They say the required audit was not done.

visual.sub: 3 returns say the required audit was not done

beats.text: The Bayview foundation, Young Community Developers, and the Housing Rights Committee.

visual.label: City paid, in the years with no audit on file
rows: Bayview Hunters Pt Fndtn For Comm Improv · June 2023
Housing Rights Committee of San Francisc · June 2024

beats.text: The Bayview foundation alone was paid 32.5 million dollars in its two years without one.

visual.label: paid to the Bayview foundation in the two years with no audit on file

beats.text: The audit may have been finished later. None had reached the clearinghouse.

visual.line: A return is filed months after the year ends, so the audit may have been finished later.

beats.text: It runs the other way too. 33 returns say no audit was required, or leave it blank.
Yet the audits exist: one shows 20.9 million in federal spending.

visual.label: federal spending in a Bay Area Community Services audit, year ended 2023-06-30

beats.text: The box on the return is not a safe guide, either way.

visual.line: The box on the return is not a safe guide either way.

beats.text: Not shown: that any audit was skipped, or anything about how the money was spent.

cards: Whether the funding departments hold copies
Anything about how the money was spent

beats.text: A box ticked in error, a parent’s audit, or one sent to the City and never uploaded.

visual.label: Other readings
visual.sub: a box ticked in error · filed by a parent · filed after 7 November 2026 · sent to the City, never uploaded

beats.text: None of 57 state renewal packages reviewed included an auditor’s report.

visual.label: renewal packages checked
visual.sub: The State does not require an audit attachment

beats.text: What would settle it?

cards.what: The single audit reports for the listed years
The copy each funding department received

beats.text: The audit reports themselves, or the copies held by the departments that fund them.

cards.what: The single audit reports for the listed years
The copy each funding department received

beats.text: No one named here was contacted, and no authority has made a finding.
A lead is a question, not an accusation.
